opt.min_hours_per_week.citation: SEVP, Study in the States, SEVIS Help Hub, F-1 Optional Practical Training (OPT), last updated 2025-05-19
opt.min_hours_per_week.quote: Post-Completion OPT: Any portion of OPT used after the student's Program End Date. It must be at least 20 hours per week or full-time.
opt.min_hours_per_week.plain: SEVP's guidance says post-completion OPT must be at least 20 hours per week or full time. This is agency guidance, not a regulation.

opt.report_employer_within_days.citation: SEVP, Study in the States, SEVIS Help Hub, F-1 Optional Practical Training (OPT), last updated 2025-05-19
opt.report_employer_within_days.quote: While on OPT, the student must report to the DSO within 10 days any changes in the student's name or address, and employment information.
opt.report_employer_within_days.plain: SEVP's guidance says that while on OPT, a student must tell the DSO of any change in name, address or employment information within 10 days. This is agency guidance, not a regulation.
